name: TestFontGenerated

source.verification: Generated files (the originals are too large to import whole: the CBDT emoji font is 10.7 MB). Tool: fontTools 4.63.0 with brotli 1.2.0, Python 3.13. Inputs: NotoColorEmoji.ttf (CBDT/CBLC) at googlefonts/noto-emoji tag v2026-09-24-unicode18_0 (e20cbc2bbec1926686be9f9bee7d1d2cfa1fea0e, SHA-256 in source.sha256), TestFontRoboto Roboto-Regular.ttf (SHA-256 9f300202f482ad59f8b13bc3131a295744d14fd530fa3765a0a11ec87264d203) and TestFontNotoNaskhArabic NotoNaskhArabic[wght].ttf (SHA-256 67b5a525a661b607971fbd3f96a81b89d3a768e74534fca84f18ac97e6fab72f). Commands: NotoColorEmoji-U1F600.ttf = fontTools.subset of the emoji font to U+1F600 (layout_features=[], name_IDs=['*'], notdef_outline=True); Roboto-NotoNaskhArabic.ttc = TTCollection of [Roboto, Noto Naskh Arabic]; Roboto-Regular.woff and .woff2 = Roboto saved with flavor woff and woff2; every TTFont loaded with recalcTimestamp=False. Two runs produce the same bytes. The license texts are byte copies of the inputs' OFL files.

notes: Fixed test font for the font library and font backend tests (Docs/Design/Font/08-ThirdParty.ko.md section 8.5): tests read the file from the repository and never use fonts installed on the machine. Not shipped in any product.

Colour bitmap glyph (CBDT PNG through libpng), font collection (two sub-faces) and WOFF/WOFF2 (FreeType zlib and Brotli paths) test inputs. The generation script is recorded in source.verification; regenerate with the same tool versions.
